vectors.precondition: A canonical approved-registry Authorization Request is still live and the Wallet user explicitly rejects it without selecting or granting an account or scope.
vectors.action: Submit the exact request-bound YNX_WALLET_AUTH_REJECTION_V1 envelope to POST /v1/wallet/authorizations/reject with no Product Session proof header; then attempt request/product/callback/time substitution, authority/scope injection, unknown fields and proof-header injection.
vectors.expectedState: stateDigest unchanged; zero sessions, consumed authorization nonces and Product Session proofs; every substitution or authority injection fails closed; no account, signature, scope or asset authority exists

vectors.precondition: A Smart Account has an active bounded Session Key and the Guardian has a valid delayed-recovery target.
vectors.action: Request Guardian Recovery, attempt the old Session Key before the delay, cancel recovery, retry the same old key, then request replacement recovery.
vectors.expectedState: session epoch increments at each recovery request; the pre-request Session Key is rejected immediately and remains rejected after cancellation; recovery execution does not add a second cutoff for the same request

vectors.precondition: A bounded Session Key is configured for one target, selector, exact calldata keccak256, native-value limits and time window.
vectors.action: Submit a correctly signed UserOperation using the same target, selector, value and time but replace or append any calldata parameter.
vectors.expectedState: UserOperation execution fails; target state and account spending counters remain unchanged; only the exact configured calldata may execute

vectors.precondition: The canonical Wallet Gateway on 127.0.0.1:6439 is active with exact build identity and emits valid identifiers, while public /v1/wallet/* traffic enters through App Gateway on 127.0.0.1:6437.
vectors.action: Preserve or generate canonical response identifier headers at the 6437 public ingress without changing bodies, status codes, replay, revoke, state or route ownership; rerun the complete public lifecycle probe.
vectors.expectedState: all five responses retain their canonical lifecycle results and valid x-request-id/x-trace-id; 409 REPLAY and 403 REVOKED also expose valid x-error-id; no identifier value is persisted in evidence

vectors.precondition: A complete public Gateway lifecycle produces completion, introspection, replay rejection, revocation and post-revocation rejection responses.
vectors.action: Inspect only the presence and UUID validity of response identifier headers without recording identifier values.
vectors.expectedState: every response carries valid x-request-id and x-trace-id; 409/403 errors also carry valid x-error-id; lifecycle success must remain independently true or false

vectors.precondition: A fresh random Wallet key and fresh random P-256 product-device key create an isolated approved Bridge Product Session against the canonical public Gateway.
vectors.action: Complete, introspect, replay the exact consumed proof, revoke with a distinct path-bound proof and introspect again with a fresh proof.
vectors.expectedState: completion 200; active introspection 200; exact replay 409 REPLAY; revoke 200; post-revoke 403 REVOKED; no asset movement; public identifier completeness remains independently gated

vectors.precondition: Four fresh random Wallet signing keys and four fresh random P-256 product-device keys target the canonical public Testnet Gateway with no existing user, provider or asset state.
vectors.action: Concurrently complete and introspect four isolated sessions; substitute one consumed proof onto another session binding; replay every exact proof; revoke every session; then submit a fresh proof to every revoked session.
vectors.expectedState: 4 unique accounts and bindings; 4 active introspections; cross-session substitution rejected with SESSION_BINDING_MISMATCH; 4 exact replays rejected with REPLAY; cleanup and post-revoke rejection 4/4; public capacity and identifier completeness remain false

vectors.precondition: A public RPC URL, Bundler URL, authoritative EntryPoint address and exact expected runtime SHA-256 are supplied without credentials.
vectors.action: Probe RPC and Bundler chain ID, exact EntryPoint runtime and Bundler-supported EntryPoints with bounded responses and timeouts.
vectors.expectedCode: process exit 2 when any required binding is absent or mismatched
vectors.expectedState: chainId, DNS/TLS, HTTP reachability, provider self-report or a test-fixture URL alone cannot enable public EntryPoint/Bundler/Paymaster/receipt claims; every unmet state remains false

vectors.precondition: A Bundler returns lookup, UserOperation receipt and inclusion transaction responses for a submitted PackedUserOperation.
vectors.action: Substitute the operation, userOpHash, EntryPoint, sender/nonce, transaction, transaction recipient, Paymaster prefix, block evidence or success status in any response.
vectors.expectedState: no finalized or sponsored success is emitted; missing finality returns BUNDLER_NOT_FINALIZED and failed execution returns BUNDLER_USER_OPERATION_FAILED

vectors.precondition: A canonical sponsorship request v2 carries an exact Product Session binding and UserOperation digest.
vectors.action: Substitute account, session binding, product device key, product, ordered scopes, anti-Sybil subject or operation digest; then retry the original request nonce.
vectors.expectedCode: binding-specific ineligible reason; exact accepted replay throws SPONSORSHIP_REPLAY
vectors.expectedState: every substituted request approves zero cost and consumes no nonce; only one eligible exact request consumes the nonce; bounded ledger exhaustion fails closed

vectors.precondition: A canonical sponsorship request v2 is eligible and the durable Node ledger has an empty private state file.
vectors.action: SIGKILL the process after file fsync, atomic rename and parent-directory fsync but before authorize returns; restart and retry the exact request.
vectors.expectedState: exactly one consumed nonce survives restart; no second sponsorship decision; multi-process and multi-region claims remain false

vectors.precondition: Eight independent Node processes share one private sponsorship replay state path.
vectors.action: Release all processes simultaneously with either eight distinct nonces or one identical nonce.
vectors.expectedState: all eight distinct nonces persist without lost update; an identical nonce has exactly one winner; reload, decision and persistence occur inside one exclusive lock

vectors.precondition: A sponsorship ledger process dies while its canonical mode-0600 owner lock remains beside a valid replay state file.
vectors.action: Attempt normal startup, too-young recovery, live/PID-reused-owner recovery, then explicit recovery after the minimum age with the owner dead.
vectors.expectedCode: SPONSORSHIP_STATE_LOCKED, SPONSORSHIP_STALE_LOCK_TOO_YOUNG or SPONSORSHIP_STALE_LOCK_OWNER_ALIVE until every recovery invariant passes
vectors.expectedState: normal startup and unsafe recovery mutate nothing; explicit recovery revalidates state plus PID/token/inode, removes only the unchanged dead-owner lock, preserves consumed nonces and exact replay rejection

vectors.precondition: The packaged sponsorship stale-lock CLI is invoked with missing policy, a too-young dead-owner lock or a recoverable dead-owner lock.
vectors.action: Run ynx-wallet-sponsorship-state-lock recover with the explicit state path and minimum-age environment contract.
vectors.expectedCode: exit 2 with canonical bounded error for missing/unsafe input; exit 0 only after the recovery invariant passes
vectors.expectedState: stdout/stderr expose no path, token, stack or source location; successful output is limited to ageMs, ownerPid and recovered; replay state bytes stay unchanged

vectors.precondition: A mutating canonical Gateway completion or revoke request has persisted its state while holding the shared state lock.
vectors.action: Observe HTTP acknowledgement and immediately SIGKILL the Gateway child process.
vectors.expectedState: the state lock was released before the response became observable; cold restart preserves exactly one completion or revoke without stale-lock recovery

vectors.precondition: Thirty-two distinct Wallet signing keys and thirty-two distinct P-256 product-device keys submit canonical Social Product Session completions over one loopback HTTP Gateway host.
vectors.action: Complete and introspect every Product Session concurrently with its own exact device-bound proof.
vectors.expectedState: 32 unique accounts and 32 unique session bindings; every exact introspection is active; no account, device or proof crosses users

vectors.precondition: One exact P-256 Product Session introspection proof has been accepted and persisted by the Gateway.
vectors.action: Replay the proof before restart and again after reconstructing the Gateway host from its mode-0600 state file.
vectors.expectedState: no second acceptance or state widening; replay rejection survives host reconstruction and is counted only under the bounded REPLAY metric label

vectors.precondition: A device-bound Product Session is active and its exact revoke proof has been accepted and persisted.
vectors.action: Reconstruct the Gateway host and submit a fresh correctly bound introspection proof for the revoked session.
vectors.expectedState: revocation remains terminal after reconstruction; no active session or success response is fabricated

vectors.precondition: One client has exhausted its canonical Gateway admission window while a second client remains within policy.
vectors.action: Submit another request from the exhausted client, then read metrics from the independent client.
vectors.expectedState: no Gateway state mutation; rejection contains request/trace/error IDs and state digest, emits one redacted bounded event, and increments only the bounded RATE_LIMIT metric label

vectors.precondition: A valid product-session proof was issued for a different requestingProduct or productClientId.
vectors.action: Submit the proof to POST /api/market/actions.
vectors.expectedState: no mutation; proof not accepted for Resource Market

vectors.precondition: A valid exact-method/path/body product-session proof has already been consumed once.
vectors.action: Replay the same proof against the same request.
vectors.expectedState: no second mutation; replay set remains persisted

vectors.precondition: Order is accepted, capacity_reserved, service_started, metered_usage or service_completed but not settlement_pending.
vectors.action: Settlement authority submits confirm_settlement.
vectors.expectedState: order state unchanged; no receipt created; capacity not released

vectors.precondition: Order is settlement_pending with signed metering totals.
vectors.action: Settlement authority submits a receipt whose grossCost, providerNet or protocolFee differs from signed metering.
vectors.expectedState: order remains settlement_pending; no receipt created; reserved capacity retained

vectors.precondition: A normalized transaction hash has already been consumed by an existing Resource Market receipt.
vectors.action: Settlement authority submits the same transaction hash with different case or surrounding whitespace for another order.
vectors.expectedState: second order remains settlement_pending; no second receipt created; no double capacity release

vectors.precondition: Provider worker key is active and a canonical meter payload was signed.
vectors.action: Change quantity, interval, order, provider, source or signature before record_usage.
vectors.expectedState: no meter, billing event or order transition

vectors.precondition: At least one signed usage interval is already accepted for the order.
vectors.action: Submit another interval that overlaps any accepted interval or begins before evidenced service start.
vectors.expectedState: no additional meter or billing event; accepted usage remains unchanged

vectors.precondition: The order already contains one or more accepted signed usage segments.
vectors.action: Submit a segment that makes cumulative usage exceed ordered units or breaks cumulative fee lineage.
vectors.expectedState: no additional meter; cumulative quantity and fee totals remain bounded

vectors.precondition: The authenticated buyer wallet is the wallet that owns the selected provider offer.
vectors.action: Create a fixed-price quote or submit an auction bid for the provider's own capacity.
vectors.expectedState: no quote, bid, order, reservation, usage or settlement mutation

vectors.precondition: One provider publishes two offers for the same resource and the first offer is fully reserved while the second retains capacity.
vectors.action: Request or reserve additional units against the exhausted first offer.
vectors.expectedState: the exhausted offer remains unavailable; sibling offer capacity is not borrowed; existing reservations remain unchanged

vectors.precondition: A requested quote, auction allocation, signed meter aggregation, settlement aggregation or dispute refund calculation would exceed the non-negative signed 64-bit amount range.
vectors.action: Execute the affected market action with an authenticated product session and otherwise valid lineage.
vectors.expectedState: no quote, bid clearing, meter, receipt, refund, reservation release or dispute decision mutation

vectors.precondition: Provider reports failure for an active reserved order.
vectors.action: Observe order, receipt and dispute state before an independently evidenced final decision and authoritative refund transaction.
vectors.expectedState: order becomes provider_failed; reservation releases; no receipt or refund is fabricated; dispute may be opened
